title: The Virtual tour of the museum
subtitle: 网络信息 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）
meta: 主题语境：网络信息（人与社会·科学与技术·网络与信息）　|　核心词汇：virtual　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 virtual 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the headmaster wrote of ① a virtual tour of the museum in the record, and everybody in the school said at once that it was ② so virtual that nobody in the school would go near it. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the headmaster, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the virtual ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the virtual tour of the museum that anybody there had ever seen, or so the record for October 1985 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too virtual to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the student who had come to help; the virtual ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bell at the far gate, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a virtual ruler of the town, and said that no student in his right mind would call it ⑥ as virtual as the ruler of the town they had once had in the old school. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was virtual or not, and he said so.

By 1998 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the record. What the line asked for was ⑦ something virtual, and nothing besides. The student from the next school called the whole plan ⑧ quite virtual; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the record kept the names of the virtual ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2001, before dawn, she wrote of another virtual tour of the museum in the same record, and the work, which took two years, seemed ⑨ no less virtual than anybody had expected. ⑩ The virtual ruler of the town that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 2003, was the one she could never quite name; the virtual ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 虚拟（前置定语 a virtual tour of the museum：1991 年校长在学籍册里记下的那件虚拟的导览）
B. adj. 虚拟／实际上（两处加强说法：so virtual that … 与 no less virtual than …）
C. adj. 虚拟／实际上（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 虚拟（表语 too virtual to do：母亲觉得它太虚拟，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 实际上（前置定语 a virtual ruler of the town：叔叔把整件事称作一桩实际上的掌权者）
F. adj. 实际上（同级比较 as virtual as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩镇上实际上的掌权者相比）
G. adj. 实际上（后置定语 something virtual：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 实际上（受程度副词修饰 quite virtual：那位学生的评价）

items.q: a virtual tour of the museum
the virtual tour of the museum that
a virtual ruler of the town
The virtual ruler of the town that

answers.why: virtual 意为“虚拟”，1991 年校长在学籍册里记下的是“一件虚拟的导览”，此处作前置定语 a virtual tour of the museum。
virtual 意为“虚拟”，此处用 so virtual that 结构，说它虚拟到学堂里没人敢靠近。
virtual 意为“虚拟”，学籍册上 十月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的虚拟博物馆的虚拟导览，等于最高级的说法。
virtual 意为“虚拟”，母亲认为这件东西“太虚拟了，谁也用不上”，too virtual to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
virtual 意为“实际上”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩实际上的掌权者”，此处作前置定语 a virtual ruler of the town。
virtual 意为“实际上”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩镇上实际上的掌权者一样实际上”，同级比较用 as virtual as。
virtual 意为“实际上”，学籍册上那半行字要的是“实际上的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something virtual。
virtual 意为“实际上”，邻学堂来的那位学生认为这套计划“相当实际上”，quite 修饰原级 virtual。
virtual 意为“实际上”，no less virtual than 表示“其实际上不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之实际上不亚于任何人的预料。
virtual 意为“实际上”，母亲 2003 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的实际上掌权者”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1991 年，校长在学籍册里记下了一件虚拟的导览。（a virtual tour of the museum）
它虚拟到学堂里没有一个人敢靠近。（so virtual that …）
母亲觉得它太虚拟，谁也用不上。（too virtual to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩实际上的掌权者。（a virtual ruler of the town）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩镇上实际上的掌权者一样实际上。（as virtual as …）
到了 1998 年，学籍册上只剩半行字：要的是一件实际上的东西。（something virtual）
answers: In 1991 the headmaster wrote of a virtual tour of the museum in the record.
It was so virtual that nobody in the school would go near it.
My mother thought it too virtual to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a virtual ruler of the town.
He said nobody would call it as virtual as the ruler of the town they had once had.
By 1998 the record asked for nothing but something virtual.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 virtual 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1991 the headmaster wrote of a virtual tour of the museum in the record, and nobody forgot it.
It was the virtual tour of the museum that anybody there had ever seen, or so the record says.
My mother thought it too virtual to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a virtual ruler of the town, and nobody argued with him.
The student from the next school called the plan quite virtual, and everybody laughed.
The virtual ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
